_comment: b4 #219 Grimalkin's private study contracts -- the NEW surfaces only (accept-at-hub via the studies node, the single-slot gate, and the turnin-graph VOICE param), from grimalkin_study_start (caster identity, no posting held, exam option hidden by forge_permit_filed=0). Delta completion/payout/tiers ride the SHIPPED board machinery already proven by board_loop/bounty_rank_loop -- this script deliberately does not re-prove them. CAPTURE FINDING (run 2): the board_accepted bool gate HIDES in BOTH directions (same as Selys's own hub, board_loop's comments) -- there is no visible-locked render, so the single-slot proof is the PAIR of exact option-array pins: fresh hub shows 'About the studies.' and NOT 'Reporting in...'; the enrolled hub shows 'Reporting in...' and NOT 'About the studies.'. Legs: (A) fresh hub exact-pin -> studies node exact-pin (the casting row's learned_magic_from_pisces row gate is MET in this fixture -- its presence in the array IS the row-gate proof) -> enroll in the field study (accept event + enrollment ack + slot state); (B) re-open -> enrolled-hub exact-pin (mutual exclusion) -> 'Reporting in on the study.' row 0 -> end-pair FIRST (end:true fires dialogue_ended before effects -- the event-order trap), then the board_turnin graph renders GRIMALKIN's not-done arm verbatim (the voice-param can-fail: a regression to the Selys default breaks this pin); (C) third open -- posting STILL held after a not-done report (no eviction, no clear), same enrolled-hub array. Seed 6; fixture rng_state governs (no combat).
